messages:
sam: Heads-up — postmortem follow-ups for last night's OOM spike on kv-shard-17. Putting all remediation items here so we have owners/timeline. TL;DR: memory residency grew unexpectedly, fragmentation spike, GC didn't reclaim fast enough.

maya: Thanks. I pulled the profiles, looks like a mix of long-lived allocations + slab fragmentation. I uploaded heap profiles to /mnt/prof/kv-17/3301/*. We should prioritize full-heap jmaps + a live jemalloc hprof. :thinking_face:

oliver: grabbed jemalloc tcache & arena stats during the incident. small dump: ```
arenas: 4 active
tcache: hit_rate 0.92
allocated: 12.3G resident: 14.8G
fragmentation: 22% -> 48% during spike
```

jin: Immediate mitigations we can push: 1) set per-shard softlimit to 85% resident 2) lower cache residency target for low-priority tenants 3) GC tuning: trigger background sweep earlier. I can open the infra PR for softlimits.

ciara: I can own eviction policy follow-ups and the policy table change. Plan: implement age-based decay + hotspot penalization, test locally, then canary on staging.

sam: Action list draft — please ack and add ETA: 1) Full heap + jemalloc profile capture (oliver) — EOD today. 2) Softlimit config + emergency rollout (jin) — PR by EOD, canary tomorrow. 3) Eviction algorithm update (ciara) — design by Fri, canary next Tue. 4) Fragmentation diagnostic runbook + detector (maya) — writeups + script by Thu. 5) Alerting thresholds and dashboards (sam/infra) — change by Mon.

infra-bot: Deploy started: infra/config#1893 -> staging (softlimit default: 0.80 -> 0.85). ETA ~7m.

oliver: Quick command I used to grab a live jemalloc profile (paste in case helpful): ```
ssh root@kv-17
curl -s localhost:9200/debug/jeprof > /tmp/kv-17-jeprof.prof
jeprof --text /usr/bin/kv-server /tmp/kv-17-jeprof.prof > /tmp/kv-17-jeprof.txt
```

maya: Fragmentation detector gist: runs periodic allocated vs resident delta and emits if delta > 30% AND long-lived list > 512MB. Will add to ops-runbooks. Also propose a temporary compaction job across shards during low-traffic window.

jin: Re: alerts — current OOM alert fires only on kernel OOM. We need an earlier signal: resident/allocated delta rising fast + background-sweep-lag. I'll add a composite alert and lower paging threshold to warn at 75% residency.

ciara: I'll update the runbook (pages/runbooks/kv-eviction.md) with steps: how to trigger compaction, how to check slab bins, and how to rollback softlimits. Will include checklist for canary.

sam: Good. Risk notes: compaction can add CPU; softlimit rollout might cause transient elevated tail latency for throughput-sensitive customers — plan the canary with traffic shaping. Also record rollback criteria (error rate > 2% or p95 latency +50ms).

oliver: One more datapoint: observed fragmentation correlated with many small allocations from tokenizer pipeline during specific requests. We should add a Prometheus histogram on small-allocation-rate as a signal.

maya: I'll attach a small trace set to the postmortem doc showing request types that triggered surge. Link: https://docs.internal/redwood/pm/kv-17-oom (will update). :link:

sam: Next steps: everyone add their PR/issue links in this thread. I'll consolidate into the postmortem tracker and assign dates. Please update the thread when tasks move to "in progress"/"done". Thanks. :thumbsup:

jin: Ack — opened infra/config#1893 and infra/alerts#402. PR link: https://git.internal/infra/config/pull/1893

ciara: Eviction design doc draft: https://docs.internal/design/kv-evict-draft (will iterate). ETA Fri.

oliver: Heap profiles uploaded: /mnt/prof/kv-17/3301/ and summarized in the pm doc.

maya: Detector script: https://tools.internal/frag-detector/kv-runner v0.1. Added to cron on staging for now.

sam: Great progress. We'll sync Fri 10:30 for handoff review. If anyone hits blockers before then ping #eng-runtime.

infra-bot: Reminder: canary rollout completed to staging. 85% softlimit in effect on staging shards.
